star_system.skill_level_unlocks: Skill Lv1 at 0 stars (just owning the character), Skill Lv2 at 2 stars, Skill Lv3 at 5 stars, Skill Lv4 at 7 stars. Skill level is separate from star/character level.
star_system.note: Stars 1 and 4 give the same stat boost per character (e.g. Alex gets +3% HP each time). Stars 3 and 6 each unlock a resonance slot.

resonance.description: Resonance allows characters to equip skills from other characters you own.
resonance.unlock_at: Star 3 (+1 slot) and Star 6 (+1 slot, 2 total)
resonance.how_it_works: A 6-star character can equip 2 borrowed skills from other characters in addition to their own skill. The borrowed skill uses the level from the character who owns it.
resonance.example: A 6-star Dracoola can equip Hou Yi's Sun Piercer and Nyanja's Cloudfooted if you own those characters.
resonance.pvp_note: Phynx's Desert Tribunal is widely considered the best resonance skill for PvP.

skill_levels.1: Gain 1 Sunpiercer stack per boss defeated. Each stack increases attack speed by 4% (max 9 stacks).
skill_levels.2: Each Sunpiercer stack additionally increases attack by 4%.
skill_levels.3: Gain 2 Sunpiercer stacks per boss defeated and 1 stack per elite defeated.
skill_levels.4: Gain 2 Sunpiercer stacks when entering battle. Each stack additionally increases crit damage by 4%.

skill_levels.1: 50% chance to encounter Valkyrie at the start.
Chance to absorb enemy HP during attacks.
skill_levels.2: Excess healing will be converted into damage on next attack.
Enemy attack is reduced for 5s after being unfrozen.
skill_levels.3: Attacks are imbued with formidable ice element.
skill_levels.4: Summons frost meteor when attacking frozen enemies.

skill_levels.1: When moving, there is a chance to enter [Focus State] increasing attack by 20% for 3s.
Mix sand into the elements. Elemental damage now also inflicts [Bleed] dealing 15% bleed damage every 0.15s.
skill_levels.2: Every 10 bleed hits increases elemental damage by 5% for 5s (max 5 stacks).
skill_levels.3: Against burning or poisoned enemies, +50% bleed damage dealt. Their burn and poison debuffs also tick 20% faster.
skill_levels.4: If enemy takes lightning or ice damage, all remaining bleed ticks are resolved immediately.

phynx.note: Widely considered the best resonance skill for PvP

skill_levels.1: The character's movement path will burn for an extended duration.
skill_levels.2: Main weapon attacks have a chance to fire 2 Cosmic Hoops at a target.
skill_levels.3: Cosmic Hoops gain fiery path and track targets.

skill_levels.1: The higher the enemy's HP, the easier it is to land a crit.
skill_levels.2: After taking damage, gain +40% crit rate and +60% crit damage for 5s.
skill_levels.3: Crit hits can insta-kill minions below 30% HP.
skill_levels.4: The farther the range (distance from enemy), the higher the crit rate, up to 15%.

skill_levels.1: Starts with a shield equal to 50% HP. When shield is active, elemental damage +10%, crit damage +30%.
skill_levels.2: Chance to summon dark energy orbs when enemies are hit; can pull hate. Energy orbs release energy rings to attack nearby enemies. Up to 3 orbs can be present.
skill_levels.3: When HP below 50%, absorbs dark energy orbs on the map to restore HP (each restores 10%). Only triggers 1 time per game.
skill_levels.4: Dark energy orbs form a binding field when destroyed. Enemies caught in the field have their projectiles slowed and damage taken increased. Field lasts 10s.

skill_levels.2: When moving, there is a chance to summon Mjolnir (aka hammers/Thor hammers) that home in on enemies dealing 100% damage.
skill_levels.3: Attacks deal lightning damage. Mjolnir inherits the hero's crit rate. After dealing a critical hit, there is a chance to paralyze enemies for 0.5s.
skill_levels.4: When paralyzing enemies, fire 3 additional mini-Mjolnirs (mini hammers).

skill_levels.1: Attacks are greatly enhanced by fire.
skill_levels.2: For every 20 fire hits, mark the enemy with the highest percentage HP on the field. After 1s, trigger a cross-shaped explosion and remove the mark, dealing 300% damage and leaving behind a burning trail.
skill_levels.3: Trigger a cross-shaped explosion at your location after marking a target dealing 300% damage and leaving a burning trail. Attack +40% for 3s after marking an enemy.
skill_levels.4: Marking an enemy frightens them. Marked enemies suffer -50% attack before exploding. Marked Players suffer -33% attack instead of -50% (PvP vs PvE difference).

skill_levels.1: Summon 3 permanent Monkey Mirages after entering battle.
skill_levels.2: When attacking or taking damage, chance to summon 1 Monkey Mirage for 10s. Up to 6 can exist.

custom_facts.text: Guild donations: You can donate 5 times per day. The first donation is free, and the remaining 4 cost 50 gems each (200 gems total). Always do at least the free donation daily!
